findings.message: Unsupported: "Add one mana of any of the exiled card's colors": ManaProduction has no option for the colours of an object an earlier ability remembered (the imprinted card). AnyColor is unrestricted, OneOf takes printed colours, ChosenColorKey reads a ChooseValue(Color) choice, and ColorOfAttachedOrTarget names an attached or targeted object, which the exiled card is neither.
